display_long_description:
# Step Into a Realistic Hunting Simulation

Explore a massive open world and track wildlife with realistic senses and behavior. Choose your own approach with rifles, bows, shotguns, hunting towers, or careful stalking. Every hunt is a new adventure.

**Explore the Wilderness**
[media]

Discover a massive open world filled with forests, mountains, rivers, and valleys. Dynamic weather, changing conditions, and fresh animal spawns make every trip into the wilderness unique.

**Hunt Wildlife with Realistic Behavior**
[media]

Animals can see, smell, and hear you. Watch the wind, move carefully, and choose your shots wisely. Larger trophy animals have sharper senses and offer greater rewards.

Master realistic weapon handling and shot placement with rifles, bows, and shotguns. A clean shot means shorter tracking and a more rewarding hunt.

**Build Your Dream Trophy Lodge**
[media]

Display your greatest achievements with our one-of-a-kind free placement trophy system. Choose poses, mounts, and place your trophies anywhere in your lodge to create your own hunting stories.

**Hunt Together**

Team up with up to 5 friends in online co-op. Explore, strategize, and share your trophies back at the lodge after the hunt.

**Join the Community**

Share your trophies, screenshots, and hunting stories with fellow hunters in our Discord community.

Discord: https://discord.gg/u5ZM8FNwBV
